department: Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering

gre_general.value: The department requires the GRE from all applicants.
gre_general.quote: All students applying for admission to Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering Graduate Program must take the Graduate Record Exam (GRE).

toefl_min.value: The department admission page gives an old-scale TOEFL 79 iBT or 550 paper score, which is not recorded; the Graduate School's 4.0 new-scale rule applies.
toefl_min.quote: all international students must submit an official score of 550 or above on the paper-based, or 79 on the internet-based

entry_route.value: Doctoral applicants with a 3.3 GPA can apply straight after a bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: Students are allowed to apply for the Doctoral Program directly after receiving a bachelor’s degree if their graduate point average is 3.3 or above

notes: The MAE admission page looks like an older template (2025 footer, $30 domestic fee, old TOEFL scale). Its GRE line conflicts with its own note that the screening committee will not review GRE scores; the current graduate page is used for the GRE value. No deadline or funding rule found.
name: Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (Ph.D.)
